notes.35: Starts MPI. Every process runs this line.
notes.38: comm_sz = how many processes were started (mpiexec -n).
notes.41: my_rank = this process's id, 0 to comm_sz - 1. This is the only thing that makes the processes behave differently.
notes.43: Same program in every process. The rank picks the branch.
notes.48: Sends strlen+1 chars (the +1 is the '\0') to rank 0, tag 0.
notes.54: Waits for the message from source q, tag 0. Looping q = 1, 2, ... is why output is in rank order.
notes.56: Only rank 0 prints the workers' greetings. Workers never print.

summaries.all: With {p} processes, all of them run the setup lines and MPI_Finalize. The if / else decides who does what.
summaries.zero: Rank 0 prints its own greeting, then receives {m} message(s), one from each worker, in rank order.
summaries.worker: Rank {r} builds a greeting and sends it to rank 0 once. It never receives, and it never prints.
